ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of high-intensity white pixels (central lobe areas) to low-intensity black pixels (perimeter and trailing edge mottling).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white regions occupy the interior of both lobes. Dense, low-intensity black pixels form a continuous band along the trailing edge and leading edge, with a concentrated dark cluster extending from the median notch into the center-point of the peduncle connection.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with an approximate internal angle of 35 degrees; the notch depth is roughly 10% of the vertical height of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the full trailing edge of both lobes. Left lobe distal tip shows 4-5 distinct, high-amplitude jagged peaks (approximately 10-15 pixels in depth) relative to the smoother inner trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curve fitted to the outer edges of both lobes, tapering to sharp points at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial cluster of 6-8 distinct low-intensity circular pixel clusters (dark spots) located on the distal third of the left lobe's ventral surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct, short, horizontal low-intensity lines located in the mid-section of the left lobe, approximately 20% distance from the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular jaggedness and potential tissue loss on the distal trailing edge of the left lobe compared to the more uniform serration pattern of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Image contains a physical identification tag at the bottom with high-contrast text: JAC 7/ 2 10107 JOHN CALAMBOKIDIS 26 Aug 87.
